housing_pipeline.description: The project proposes to demolish an existing 2-story 3 dwelling unit building and construct a new four story building with a basement. The project will utilize the Local Accessory Dwelling Unit program to construct four ADUs on the ground floor and the Fourplex Density Exemption, for this RH-2 zoning district, to construct 6 additional units above the ground floor on floor two through four with two units on each floor for a total of 10 units on the property. The project is seeking a Variance from the rear yard setback. The project will be complete a mandatory seismic upgrade and is not eligible for SB 423.

Per AB 2011, the proposal is for a new seven-story, mixed-use building with 99 residential units, 18 affordable low-income units at 55% AMI, two penthouses, open space, roof deck, and five commercial retail spaces located on the ground floor.

5630 Mission Street will be a renovation construction on existing buildings with a total of 20,977 square feet of space. There are three existing buildings which together include 52 hotel rooms, community spaces for resident use, and a detached property management and services offices. The 3-buildings include a 4-story tower built in 1965 which has three floors of residential (encompassing 24 hotel rooms), tuck-under parking stalls and laundry room, a second 2-story L-shaped building with 26 hotel rooms and a 2-story management building.

items.title: Adopt a Motion of Support to Allocate $22,651,000 in Prop L Funds and Allocate $1,860,572 in Prop AA Funds, with Conditions, for Ten Requests

Projects: Prop L:  SFMTA: Mission Street SoMa Transit Improvements ($700,000), Cable Car Barn Rehabilitation – Electrical System Upgrade ($3,496,000), Paratransit ($14,329,000), Inner Sunset Bike Connection ($150,000), Safe Routes to School Non-Infrastructure ($243,000), Fulton Street Safety Improvements [NTP] ($449,000). SFPW: Geary Boulevard Improvements Phase 2 ($1,800,000), Mission SoMa Improvements and Pavement Renovation ($1,400,000). TIMMA: Treasure Island On-Island Shuttle Start-Up Phase 1 ($84,000). Prop AA: SFPW: Front St and Sansome Pavement Renovation ($1,860,572).

Adopt a Motion of Support to Amend the Prop K Standard Grant Agreement for the District 2 Safety Study and Implementation [NTIP Planning and Capital] (Project) to Update the Project Scope, Schedule, Cost, and Funding Plan; and Release $430,000 on Reserve to Implement District 2 Safety Study Near-Term Recommendations

Adopt a Motion of Support to Allocate $180,800 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions, to the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency and Appropriate $49,900 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions, for the Central Subway North Beach Extension Study
Adopt a Motion of Support to Adopt the Geary/19th Ave Subway and Regional Connections Study Final Report
Internal Accounting Report, Investment Report, and Debt Expenditure Report for the Nine Months Ending March 31, 2026 - INFORMATION*
State and Federal Legislation Update - INFORMATION*
Adopt a Motion of Support to Adopt the Inner Sunset Transportation Study Final Report
Adopt a Motion of Support to Adopt the Proposed Fiscal Year 2026/27 Budget and Work Program
